comments.content: Double-encoding of credentials: `url.UserPassword` already percent-encodes the user and password when the URL is serialized via `u.String()`. Wrapping them in `url.QueryEscape` first will result in double-encoding (e.g. a password `p@ss` becomes `p%2540ss`), producing an incorrect URI and failing authentication for credentials containing special characters. Pass the raw values: `u.User = url.UserPassword(config.User, config.Password)`.
